script: Gravity on Mars is only about 38 percent of Earth's. If you weigh 50 kilograms on Earth, you would feel like 19 kilograms there. You could jump about two and a half times higher than you can here. A day on Mars is almost the same length as ours, about 24 hours and 40 minutes. Scientists call a Martian day a sol.
